'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Russia–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish]] [[artillery]] [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] kills a [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian soldier]] and injures four others in northern [[Aleppo governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/reports-turkish-shelling-north-syria-kills-russian-soldier-100006243 (ABC News)] [https://www.syriahr.com/en/301197/ (SOHR)]
*[[Ituri conflict]]
**At least 46 people are killed by [[CODECO]] in an [[Internally displaced person|IDP camp]] in the Bahema Badjere district of [[Ituri]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-40-killed-militia-attack-camp-displaced-people-congos-ituri-2023-06-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Pat Sajak]] announces his retirement from the American game show ''[[Wheel of Fortune (American game show)|Wheel of Fortune]]'' after 41 seasons, having hosted the show since 1981. [https://apnews.com/article/pat-sajak-retirement-wheel-of-fortune-d64841758855e579b3d6254b5314fc17 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Moldova–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Moldova]] and [[Ukraine]] sign an agreement to build a bridge across their [[Moldova–Ukraine border|border]] over the [[Dniester]] river between [[Cosăuți]], Moldova, and [[Yampil, Vinnytsia Oblast|Yampil]], Ukraine, bypassing the unrecognised state of [[Transnistria]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/ukraine-moldova-construct-bridge-across-144900894.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[Eritrea]] rejoins the [[Intergovernmental Authority on Development]] [[trade bloc]] almost 16 years after suspending its membership in 2007. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/10/502874/World/Africa/Eritrea-rejoins-East-African-bloc-IGAD-Information.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]
*[[UNESCO]] Director-General [[Audrey Azoulay]] announces that the [[United States]] will reapply for [[Member states of UNESCO|membership]] in July, after the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] withdrew the United States from the agency in 2018. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/06/13/news/national/us-to-rejoin-unesco-this-year/1895813 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Mexican general election]]
**[[Mexico|Mexican]] [[Secretary of Foreign Affairs (Mexico)|Foreign Minister]] [[Marcelo Ebrard]] resigns and announces he will run for [[president of Mexico]] in the 2024 elections. The [[mayor of Mexico City]], [[Claudia Sheinbaum]], also announces that she will resign on Friday to focus on running for president. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/13/top-mexican-officials-resign-in-preparation-for-presidential-runs (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Death and state funeral of Silvio Berlusconi]]
**Former [[Italian Prime Minister]] [[Silvio Berlusconi]] dies in [[Milan]] at the age of 86. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65877241 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Astronomers announce in the journal ''[[Nature Astronomy]]'' the discovery of  BEBOP-1c, an [[exoplanet]] orbiting the [[binary star]] system, [[TOI-1338]]. The system is the second discovered to have more than one [[circumbinary planet]]. [https://www.space.com/tatooine-exoplanet-binary-systeim-twin-suns (Space.com)]
*Most major communities on [[social media]] site [[Reddit]] implement a temporary "blackout" in response to proposed changes to third-party access to Reddit's [[Application programming interface|API]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/reddit-blackout-thousands-of-communities-are-doing-dark-today-heres-why-12899280 (Sky News)]
*The [[Federal administration of Switzerland|Swiss Federal Administration]] reports a [[distributed denial-of-service attack|distributed denial of service attack]] on some of its websites. [https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/international/swiss-federal-administration-under-cyberattack-ministry (''The Business Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 NBA playoffs]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[Denver Nuggets]] win their first [[List of NBA champions|NBA title]] after defeating the [[Miami Heat]] in five games of a [[Playoff format#Best-of-seven playoff|best-of-seven series]] in the [[2023 NBA Finals|NBA Finals]]. [[Serbia]]n [[Center (basketball)|center]] [[Nikola Jokić]] is named [[NBA Finals Most Valuable Player Award|Most Valuable Player]]. [https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/37844095/nuggets-finish-heat-5-games-win-first-nba-championship (ESPN)]
